Активен режим, выбранный выше. FSR 4 мож: The selected upscaler is active. You can select FSR 4 again.
FSR 4.1.1 в режиме INT8: модель из DLL A: FSR 4.1.1 uses an INT8 model reproduced from AMD's 4.1.1 DLL in Vulkan. One model covers Native through Performance, with a separate Ultra Performance model. Assets: tools/fsr4cap/build_assets.sh (requires the DLLs and Proton).
FSR 4 в режиме INT8 (модель v07 из исход: FSR 4 uses an INT8 model v07 from AMD FidelityFX SDK. It can improve image quality over FSR 3.1, but its GPU pass is heavier. Changing the preset rebuilds the model. Assets: tools/fetch_fsr4_assets.sh.
Проверка при гостинге: сеть FSR 4 нормир: If you see ghosting, test whether exposure handling or jitter sign is responsible. These options apply immediately.
TAA сглаживает сцену в разрешении вывода: TAA applies anti-aliasing at output resolution without FSR upscaling. Your saved FSR preset is restored when you switch back to FSR.
При выводе не 1080p вся игра рисуется в: At output resolutions other than 1080p, the startup patch renders the full scene at the selected preset resolution. This is fastest on low-power GPUs. Changes to the preset or output resolution require a restart. Live resolution changes below avoid restarting but keep post-processing at 1080p, which is slower.
BB_RENDER_RES фиксирует размер сцены при: BB_RENDER_RES fixes the scene resolution at launch. Clear this environment variable to change the resolution and preset without restarting.
Native AA runs FSR at output resolution for anti-aliasing. Other presets reduce the scene resolution relative to output. The HUD stays at output resolution. Preset changes apply on the next frame.
До 1 — резкость самого апскейлера (RCAS): Up to 1 controls the upscaler's RCAS sharpening. Above 1 adds another RCAS pass. Ctrl-click the slider to enter an exact value.
Каждый кадр сцена сдвигается на долю пик: The scene shifts by a fraction of a pixel each frame so the upscaler can combine details from several frames. With jitter off, it only smooths using frame history.
Помечает прозрачные эффекты (частицы, ды: Marks transparent effects such as particles and fog so the upscaler relies less on previous frames. This reduces trails but can bring back shimmer beneath effects.
Точные векторы для анимированных объекто: Accurate vectors for animated objects reduce breakup on clothing and weapons in motion. Static scenes do not get an extra pass. Restart the game to apply this change.
Красный/зелёный: движение по горизонтали: Red/green show horizontal/vertical motion (8 pixels = full brightness). Blue marks a pixel with an object vector, in addition to camera motion. Without those vectors, the upscaler treats a moving object as still and can leave a trail.
Размер готового кадра и интерфейса. Прес: The final frame and HUD resolution. The preset sets scene resolution relative to output: 4K Performance renders the scene at 1920x1080. Restart the game to apply.
Размер готового кадра и интерфейса меняе: The final frame and HUD resolution change at the next frame boundary. The preset sets scene resolution relative to output: 4K Performance renders at 1920x1080. Changing size resets FSR history and may briefly pause the game.
Включена: разрешение вывода и пресет мен: On lets you change output resolution and preset without restarting, but game post-processing stays at 1080p and can be slower. Off renders the full scene at the preset resolution and applies changes after restart. Auto enables live changes on powerful discrete GPUs. Restart the game to apply this setting.
Эффекты включаются и выключаются патчами: Game effects are patched at launch (patches/Bloodborne.xml). Motion blur and dynamic light shadows can significantly load the GPU.
Свободная камера: удерживайте Cross и на: Free camera: hold Cross and press L3 (keyboard: Space + Z). Debug menu: left touchpad / Tab. Requires DbgFont14h.ccm and DbgFont14h.tpf in dvdroot_ps4/font from Nexus mod #253. Right touchpad: Backspace.
Изменения применятся после перезапуска и: Changes apply after restarting the game
